list.name: project
list.label: Service project
list.query: SELECT name FROM projects ORDER BY name

options.content: Select a service project with real **production** deployment and incident data. No management/bootstrap syncs are classified as production. Missing source commits mean unavailable lead time. Missing incident ingestion can make failure/recovery values misleading. Recovery covers deployment-related incidents; rework requires explicit incident-linked release classification. No developer rankings or fixed industry-tier thresholds.

panels.title: Production deployments
panels.description: Successful production service releases. Resyncs reuse release IDs.

targets.rawSql:
WITH deployments AS (
  SELECT c.cicd_deployment_id AS id, max(c.finished_date) AS finished_at,
         bool_or(c.display_title LIKE 'remediation:%') AS remediation
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits c
  JOIN project_mapping p ON p.row_id = c.cicd_scope_id AND p."table" = 'cicd_scopes'
  WHERE p.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
    AND c.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND c.result = 'SUCCESS'
  GROUP BY c.cicd_deployment_id
  HAVING $__timeFilter(max(c.finished_date))
)
SELECT count(*) AS "Deployments" FROM deployments

panels.title: Change lead time (deployed source commit)
panels.description: Median committed source SHA → first healthy production observation. Requires source commits collected by the GitHub connector; covers deployed SHAs, not every intermediate commit in a release batch.

targets.rawSql:
WITH deployments AS (
  SELECT c.cicd_deployment_id AS id, max(c.finished_date) AS finished_at,
         bool_or(c.display_title LIKE 'remediation:%') AS remediation
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits c
  JOIN project_mapping p ON p.row_id = c.cicd_scope_id AND p."table" = 'cicd_scopes'
  WHERE p.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
    AND c.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND c.result = 'SUCCESS'
  GROUP BY c.cicd_deployment_id
  HAVING $__timeFilter(max(c.finished_date))
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (d.finished_at - c.committed_date))) AS "Seconds"
FROM deployments d
JOIN cicd_deployment_commits dc ON dc.cicd_deployment_id = d.id
JOIN commits c ON c.sha = dc.commit_sha
WHERE c.committed_date <= d.finished_at

panels.title: Change fail rate (incident attribution)
panels.description: Distinct deployments with a matched incident / deployments. DevLake temporal matching needs review; missing incident ingestion is not proof of a zero failure rate.

targets.rawSql:
WITH deployments AS (
  SELECT c.cicd_deployment_id AS id, max(c.finished_date) AS finished_at,
         bool_or(c.display_title LIKE 'remediation:%') AS remediation
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits c
  JOIN project_mapping p ON p.row_id = c.cicd_scope_id AND p."table" = 'cicd_scopes'
  WHERE p.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
    AND c.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND c.result = 'SUCCESS'
  GROUP BY c.cicd_deployment_id
  HAVING $__timeFilter(max(c.finished_date))
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT r.deployment_id)::double precision / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT d.id), 0) AS "Failure rate"
FROM deployments d
LEFT JOIN project_incident_deployment_relationships r ON r.deployment_id = d.id
  AND r.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})

panels.title: Failed deployment recovery time
panels.description: Median production deployment completion → resolution of a matched incident. Unresolved incidents are excluded and shown separately.

targets.rawSql:
WITH deployments AS (
  SELECT c.cicd_deployment_id AS id, max(c.finished_date) AS finished_at,
         bool_or(c.display_title LIKE 'remediation:%') AS remediation
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits c
  JOIN project_mapping p ON p.row_id = c.cicd_scope_id AND p."table" = 'cicd_scopes'
  WHERE p.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
    AND c.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND c.result = 'SUCCESS'
  GROUP BY c.cicd_deployment_id
  HAVING $__timeFilter(max(c.finished_date))
)
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (i.resolution_date - d.finished_at))) AS "Seconds"
FROM deployments d
JOIN project_incident_deployment_relationships r ON r.deployment_id = d.id
  AND r.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
JOIN incidents i ON i.id = r.id
WHERE i.resolution_date >= d.finished_at

panels.title: Deployment rework rate
panels.description: Explicit remediation releases / production deployments. Requires delivery.purpose=remediation and an incidentId.

targets.rawSql:
WITH deployments AS (
  SELECT c.cicd_deployment_id AS id, max(c.finished_date) AS finished_at,
         bool_or(c.display_title LIKE 'remediation:%') AS remediation
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits c
  JOIN project_mapping p ON p.row_id = c.cicd_scope_id AND p."table" = 'cicd_scopes'
  WHERE p.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
    AND c.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND c.result = 'SUCCESS'
  GROUP BY c.cicd_deployment_id
  HAVING $__timeFilter(max(c.finished_date))
)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE remediation)::double precision / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS "Rework rate"
FROM deployments

panels.title: Open production incidents
panels.description: Open incidents in selected service projects. These must not disappear behind a low recovery-time statistic.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT i.id) AS "Open incidents"
FROM incidents i
JOIN project_mapping p ON p.row_id = i.scope_id AND p."table" = i."table"
WHERE p.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring}) AND i.resolution_date IS NULL

panels.title: Source provenance coverage
panels.description: Fraction of deployment commit records with a known source timestamp; a missing lead-time sample is not zero.

targets.rawSql:
WITH deployments AS (
  SELECT c.cicd_deployment_id AS id, max(c.finished_date) AS finished_at,
         bool_or(c.display_title LIKE 'remediation:%') AS remediation
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits c
  JOIN project_mapping p ON p.row_id = c.cicd_scope_id AND p."table" = 'cicd_scopes'
  WHERE p.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
    AND c.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND c.result = 'SUCCESS'
  GROUP BY c.cicd_deployment_id
  HAVING $__timeFilter(max(c.finished_date))
)
SELECT count(c.sha)::double precision / NULLIF(count(dc.id), 0) AS "Coverage"
FROM deployments d
JOIN cicd_deployment_commits dc ON dc.cicd_deployment_id = d.id
LEFT JOIN commits c ON c.sha = dc.commit_sha AND c.committed_date <= d.finished_at

panels.title: Deployment trend
panels.description: Distinct production service releases per day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH deployments AS (
  SELECT c.cicd_deployment_id AS id, max(c.finished_date) AS finished_at,
         bool_or(c.display_title LIKE 'remediation:%') AS remediation
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits c
  JOIN project_mapping p ON p.row_id = c.cicd_scope_id AND p."table" = 'cicd_scopes'
  WHERE p.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
    AND c.environment = 'PRODUCTION' AND c.result = 'SUCCESS'
  GROUP BY c.cicd_deployment_id
  HAVING $__timeFilter(max(c.finished_date))
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', finished_at) AS time, count(*) AS "Deployments"
FROM deployments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
